visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A split-screen graphic displays logos for FamilyMart and 'Fami 煮煮' alongside '型男大主廚'. A numerical counter rapidly increases from 4,750 to 10,000 against a vibrant orange and green background with falling digital confetti. (2) Five male chefs in professional white culinary uniforms appear in vertical panels, each performing a signature pose like thumbs up or holding a utensil. Their names are displayed below each panel against colorful striped backgrounds. (3) A fast-paced montage showcases high-quality close-ups of five different gourmet dishes, including a creamy curry, braised pork belly with vegetables, and seafood pasta with black sauce, emphasizing texture and color. (4) A chef in his 40s with short black hair smiles warmly at the camera while pointing his index finger upward. A digital overlay representing a mobile app interface floats in front of him against a gray brick wall background. (5) Close-up shots of raw ingredients like fresh shrimp and broccoli are shown on wooden plates, followed by a bright yellow scoop of cooked rice, highlighting the simplicity of preparation. (6) A dramatic close-up of a chef looking intently at a small pinch of seasoning between his fingers, emphasizing precision in flavor. (7) The five chefs are shown together in a group shot, smiling and gesturing towards various meal boxes and the mobile app icon. (8) A final graphic provides instructions on how to order through the FamilyMart app, with the brand logo and images of the collaboration dishes featured at the bottom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy electronic pop BGM starts immediately with a strong 4/4 beat. A male narrator speaks with high arousal, announcing '銷量破萬' (sales exceeding 10,000) over the sound of cheering crowds and a festive pop sound effect. (2) The BGM continues with a consistent synth melody while the narrator introduces the collaboration between 'Fami 煮煮' and '型男大主廚'. He lists the chefs' names with a professional but enthusiastic cadence. (3) The audio texture remains bright as the narrator shifts to describing the '人氣口味' (popular flavors), his voice modulation increasing to emphasize the variety of dishes. (4) A distinctive 'ding' sound effect marks a transition to instructional content. The narrator explains how easy it is to use the app, his speech rate accelerating slightly to match the fast visual cuts of ingredient preparation. (5) The narrator's tone becomes more persuasive and triumphant in the final seconds, concluding with a call to action to order via the app. The music reaches its final peak with a crisp electronic stinger as the narrator delivers the final brand slogan.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction -> Product Showcase -> Benefits -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a high-energy promotional advertisement for the collaboration between FamilyMart's meal kit brand 'Fami 煮煮' and the professional chefs from the popular TV show '型男大主廚'. It uses strong social proof by highlighting a 10,000-pack sales milestone to build credibility. By showcasing the chefs' endorsement and emphasizing 'zero mistakes' in seasoning and time-saving preparation, the video targets busy individuals or novice cooks who want gourmet flavors with convenience. The narrative effectively transitions from achievement to talent, then to product variety, and finally to a simple mobile-app-based call to action.
